The bill page lists Dixon among the sponsors of House Bill 958, Election Law Changes (filed 2025-04-10 with two primary sponsors; the date Dixon was added is not shown on the page, so the date is given as the year). The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) says the person taking a voter registration application at a drivers license office shall proceed only if the applicant affirmatively states that the applicant is a citizen of the United States. It adds G.S. 163-83, requiring a citizenship answer on registration forms, with a notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the answer is blank. It also directs the State Board of Elections to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill page shows the Governor vetoed it on 08/17/2026. Not checked here: whether the bill requires documents as proof of citizenship, and Dixon's roll-call votes on it.
